desc: Attended hpm2-only PD/VBUS test with the exact corrected DTB reviewed PASS in completed ticket 3009, paired with its pinned Image/initramfs and existing ticket hashes. Preserve maxcpus=1, disabled ANS/NVMe and the SPMI_SAFETY Entry 1 transaction envelope: WAKEUP/reads/SSPS-to-S0, INT_MASK1 and event W1C INT_CLEAR1 on right hpm2 only. CJ attendance, confirmed S128 fixture and lease are required at execution. Capture driver/typec state and USB child enumeration; PASS requires sane hpm2 status plus S128 child persistence for 10 seconds. Identification only: no mounts or block reads (109 owns those). Stop on SError, DART fault, firmware panic, unexpected reset, console loss, out-of-envelope SPMI error/access or unauthorized write; preserve transcript and use sanctioned recovery. Runs 1–4 used raw bus address 0x309198000 instead of CPU physical 0x509198000 and do not establish a real a1 stall; do not repeat the disproved AHB-parent experiment. Historical run narrative is preserved in evidence. October base-M4 USB success does not close this T6040 VBUS boundary. CROSS-CHECK 2026-10-31 (wallace-rex 4d5b016, checked against our code in evidence/2026-10-31-t6040-305-spmi-hpm-crosscheck-review-request.md): run 8 is not blocked. (1) zero-write reply check is stricter than macOS (mask 0xf80 + ACK) but the same as m1n1 spmi_reg0_write, which passed on J614s hpm2 in tickets 093-095, so the value echo is real; low risk. (2) tps6598x_spmi_select returns -EIO on any readback other than reg or reg|0x80 and does NOT log it; macOS re-issues the select and keeps polling (1000 x 1 ms). Worth a logging-only fix (print reg/sel/i) if the pddiag image is rebuilt anyway; the retry behaviour needs the SPMI_SAFETY review. (3) read-length byte at 0x1f and (4) write window 0xa0 with a re-select commit are parity items for the write phase, not for run 8 reads.
author: fable
review:
BINARY REVIEW FAIL 2026-08-19 (opus, non-builder). buildA hashes/config/markers/hpm2-endpoint all correct AND hpm2 is the sole PD node, BUT the artifact violates its own 'hpm2 ONLY via the DT gate': with SPMI_APPLE=y (bus live this boot) plus NVMEM_APPLE_SPMI=y + MFD_MACSMC=y + RTC_DRV_MACSMC=y, the DTB leaves the PMU SPMI bus spmi@509014000 status=okay with pmic@e (apple,abbey-pmic/spmi-nvmem), and smc@50c600000's smc-rtc + smc-reboot consume its cells -> the run WILL read (boot) and write (shutdown: boot_stage/shutdown_flag) the abbey-pmic PMU (SID 0x0e) over SPMI, a second endpoint the sign-off never enumerated. Fails on the gate/sign-off mismatch and on confounding 305's own falsifiers/STOP conditions; whether the standing smc nvram grant extends to raw Linux SPMI transport is CJ's explicit call. FIX (fable, preferred): DTB set spmi@509014000 (or pmic@e) status=disabled, leaving only spmi@309198000/hpm2; every prior proven boot ran with SPMI_APPLE=m and these lookups finding no provider, so this restores known-good behavior. Since a re-spin is now required, make it TWO fresh-tree builds to also close the single-build byte-repro honesty note. OR: CJ explicitly widens the 305 envelope to include the abbey-pmic cells. Re-review checklist in the evidence doc. RESOLVED -> PASS 2026-08-19 (opus): CJ chose to widen the envelope rather than gate the DT. Brick-risk analysis (primary source): the abbey PMU is exposed to Linux ONLY as a bounded apple,spmi-nvmem provider (drivers/nvmem/apple-spmi-nvmem.c, not a regulator, no voltage/rail/OTP path); btm (SID 0x0b) and abbeyF1/F2 (nub-spmi1/2) have no Linux DT node and no driver; the cells are boot-policy/RTC scratch written by iBoot/macOS every boot, DFU-recoverable worst case; it is the production Asahi RTC/reboot stack. NO brick risk in what buildA reaches. SPMI_SAFETY.md rewritten to allow the bounded abbey nvmem (Entry 2) and record the signed-off tps6598x hpm2 driver envelope (Entry 1); raw abbey register writes / voltage / btm / RESET stay prohibited. buildA is IN-ENVELOPE as-is -> no DT change required (optional-conservative gate if ever wanted: '&nub_spmi0 { status="disabled"; };'). Reviewer accepts the single build for this volatile, warm-reboot-recoverable attended run (honesty note stays, not a blocker). RUN PROCEDURE SAFEGUARD (added): the attended operator MUST confirm the probe-time abbey nvmem READS look sane (boot_stage small int, panic_count small, rtc_offset plausible) BEFORE any Linux-initiated reboot exercises the abbey WRITE path -- the cell offsets were project-measured on this PMIC generation, not inherited, so the reads validate the offsets. Attended run is GO pending CJ's window.

---

CROSS-REVIEW 2026-08-19 (opus, fresh session, at CJ request). The runs 1-5 'a1 controller hard-stalls' conclusion is REFUTED: it is a raw-vs-CPU-physical DT address error, independently verified from t6040.dtsi /soc empty ranges + the working nub_spmi0 at translated 0x509014000 vs the a1 node driven at raw 0x309198000 (309198000 + arm-io base 0x200000000 = 0x509198000). spmi0 works and a1 stalls purely because a1 used the untranslated address; runs 1-5 never addressed the real a1 bank. The desc NEXT OPTIONS (instrumented patch / re-pin July m1n1 / kext RE) are superseded by the DT-only address fix (tickets 3000 audit, 3008 corrected DTB). I then performed the 3009 exact review of the corrected artifact: PASS (evidence/2026-08-19-t6040-3009-spmi-a1-physfix-binary-review-PASS.md) -- byte-identical eaf8cceb DTB, a1 reg 0x509198000, zero stale 0x309198000, single hpm2 SID 0x0c source/host, NVMe disabled, abbey nvmem bounded (pm_setting has no phandle -> unread), Image/initramfs/config hashes unchanged and in-envelope for SPMI_SAFETY Entries 1+2. RESUME GATE: attended 305 resumes on the eaf8cceb DTB ONLY; the pinned dd57776e (v3) is the known-stalling raw-address DTB and MUST NOT be booted. Carry the abbey read-before-write safeguard from the prior review. Dep 3009 added; boot DTB re-pinned to eaf8cceb below.

dd57776e… SUPERSEDED (raw-address v3, hung in runs 1-5); do NOT boot. Use the physfix eaf8cceb DTB. (v2 05e6acee, v1 36e5c462 also raw-address, hung)

run7_expectation_2026_10_25: Per the 25F84 RE (evidence/2026-10-24-t6040-hpm2-source-vbus-re.md): macOS issues NO VBUS/power-path/power-role/port-config write after S0; the SN201202x firmware sources VBUS itself when it sees a sink. So run 7 (pdwake fb8cd3c4) PASS path = WAKEUP ok, power-state 0x07, VID nonzero, SSPS->S0, typec port registered, S128 enumerates within ~10 s. If it binds + S0 but no VBUS (PARTIAL): do NOT poke writes; capture the R0 connector-state set (STATUS 0x1a, PD status 0x40, data status 0x5f, power path 0x3f if named, 0x28 PORTINFO) via the 5002 diagnostic. Note: macOS settles 100 ms after WAKEUP (ours 10 ms, m1n1-proven); raise only if the first read is flaky. Preserve full dmesg before any dmesg -c.
